flavours.title: Synths, USB audio, Bluetooth audio and MIDI
flavours.description: The default build (profile mots-config): ANALOG 2 with its four filter models, DIGITAL, PHASE, LOFI, DRONE, VPS, FM6 (five voice packs), PLAITS, STRINGS, PROPHET, CS80, PHYS, ACID, JUNO, CZ and NOISE; the X0X 909 and 808 drums; the sequencer with grids, Euclid and LFO generators; USB audio, Bluetooth MIDI, Bluetooth audio, Wi-Fi link, and the web editor's screen mirror.
